sources.title: GitHub - decido-ai/decido: Calibrated decision model that beats Jev 1. ...
sources.snippet: Decido takes a state (text, JSON or a list) and typed questions, and returns a probability for every answer in the same wire format as TypeSafe's Jev "System One" API. The model is a LoRA fine-tune of Gemma 4 26B-A4B (~4B active parameters), shipped as an 8-bit GGUF for llama.cpp.
